description: Defines the SocketBIOAdapter class, which acts as an adapter between StreamSocket and OpenSSL BIO I/O models, facilitating asynchronous socket I/O operations for SSL/TLS implementations.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that bridges StreamSocket asynchronous I/O with OpenSSL BIO interface, managing read/write buffers and signaling readiness via delegate callbacks.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when the socket is ready for read or write operations.

methods.name: HasPendingReadData
methods.description: Checks if there is unread data from the socket that has not yet been consumed by BIO.

methods.name: GetAllocationSize
methods.description: Estimates the buffer allocation size in bytes.

methods.name: BIORead
methods.description: Performs a BIO read operation from the socket.

methods.name: HandleSocketReadResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a socket read operation.

methods.name: OnSocketReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of socket read.

methods.name: OnSocketReadIfReadyComplete
methods.description: Callback for conditional socket read completion.

methods.name: BIOWrite
methods.description: Performs a BIO write operation to the socket.

methods.name: SocketWrite
methods.description: Initiates writing buffered data to the socket.

methods.name: HandleSocketWriteResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a socket write operation.

methods.name: OnSocketWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of socket write.

methods.name: CallOnReadReady
methods.description: Triggers the delegate callback indicating the socket is ready for reading.

methods.name: GetAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the adapter instance from a BIO pointer.

methods.name: BIOReadWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIO read operation.

methods.name: BIOWriteWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIO write operation.

methods.name: BIOCtrlWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIO control commands.
